name: Bangkok Skyline & CentralWorld 24/7 Live Cam
description: 24/7 panoramic high-definition live webcam capturing the downtown Bangkok skyscraper skyline, sunset over CentralWorld, and vibrant evening highway light trails.

name: Chao Phraya River & Wat Arun Temple Live Cam
description: Continuous real-time river cam overlooking the Chao Phraya River, illuminated Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn), commuter express boats, and illuminated dinner cruise flotillas.

name: Asok Montri & Sukhumvit Live Cam
description: Live street-level broadcast of pedestrian foot traffic, BTS Skytrain flyovers, and motorcycle queues at Bangkok's busiest intersection outside Terminal 21.

name: Khaosan Road 24/7 Street Pulse Cam
description: Live camera capturing round-the-clock street activity along Khaosan Road: daytime fruit carts, backpacker energy, evening acoustic sets, and midnight neon revelry.
